attempts.note: Meta serves no OpenAPI document from graph.facebook.com or developers.facebook.com (tried /openapi.json, /openapi.yaml, /swagger.json, /.well-known/openapi.json and the reference pages' .json/.md variants). The vendor spec is published on GitHub instead (see the facebook/openapi attempt).

Meta's own machine-readable index of every endpoint reference page, plus the matching .md rendering of each page. The pages are generated from Meta's internal spec and carry base URL, method, path, parameter tables, request/response content types and component schemas, so the whole documented surface is enumerable rather than guessed. Superseded on 2026-11-14 by Meta's own OpenAPI (facebook/openapi), kept here as the earlier source.

The three Flows reference pages Meta's index links (flows/reference/api-for-whatsapp-flows, whatsapp-extension-preview-api, whatsapp-flow-metric-data-point-api) do not resolve — they return the 'Page Not Found' shell. The Flows and Metrics guides document the same endpoints in full, so the Flows paths were authored from those. Superseded on 2026-11-14 by Meta's own OpenAPI (facebook/openapi), kept here as the earlier source.

Meta's own Business SDK codegen specs are a proprietary node/edge format, and only a few WhatsApp nodes are published (WhatsAppBusinessAccount, WhatsAppBusinessProfile). No phone-number node and none of the Cloud API messaging or media endpoints. Used only to cross-check the WABA edge list.
Third-party (unblu) spec of the retired WhatsApp Business on-premises API v1.0, not the Cloud API this adaptor calls.
Meta's public workspace renders client-side; the collection JSON is not reachable without a Postman API key.

Meta's official OpenAPI 3.1 for the WhatsApp Business Platform (MIT, 'intended to formally describe a product area's complete specification'), Graph API v23.0: 78 paths, 113 operations, 369 schemas covering Cloud API messaging, media, groups, calling, phone-number registration, business profiles, templates, Flows, WABAs, solutions and partner onboarding. Every path from the docs-authored spec has a counterpart here except GET/POST /{business-id}/whatsapp_business_accounts. Saved verbatim as upstream.yaml.

notes: The WhatsApp Business Platform over the Meta Graph API (graph.facebook.com). Source of truth is Meta's own OpenAPI 3.1 document from github.com/facebook/openapi (business-messaging-api_v23.0.yaml), saved byte-for-byte as upstream.yaml; openapi.json is it normalised. Paths carry the Graph version as a leading path parameter (/{Version}/{Phone-Number-ID}/messages), which is how the adaptor calls it: its generic request(method, path, body) joins the configured apiVersion and phoneNumberId onto the path. This replaces the 2026-09-13 spec authored from Meta's reference .md pages (106 ops / 70 paths); cross-checked against it, the vendor spec covers every documented node and edge except /{business-id}/whatsapp_business_accounts, and adds the encrypted-messages, message-history, migration-intent and OBO mobility endpoints. Meta publishes only v23.0 in that repo; when it adds a newer file, re-run convert with its URL. Graph nodes share one URL shape (/{Version}/{node-id}), so several root node paths are identical templates distinguished only by the kind of ID.
